svg.text: the recursive (TRM) variant of gmedmamba.py — drawn from the code, one weight-shared core instead of four stages
Conv3×3 → BN → LeakyReLU ×2 → Conv3×3 · OFF in every reported run
Spectral Pathway · why C never appears in a weight
LN → Conv1d k=3 ALONG THE BAND AXIS → GELU → Linear → ⊕
SpectralMamba · bidirectional selective scan over bands
Linear → (x, z); scan forward + backward → softmax mix → LN → ⊗ SiLU(z) → Linear
C disappears here — output is [32] for any C
Recursive Core (TRM) · one f, called 63 times
for improve t = 1 … 3 t < 3 runs under torch.no_grad()
(6 + 1) × 3 improve × 3 segments = 63 applications of f = 126 block calls
every call to f is gradient-checkpointed — without it 63 live graphs exhaust a 16 GB card
